The instructions are lacking any real information- maybe it’s user error and I have something turned off that needs to be turned on??? I generally don’t turn things off while walking- after taking “2 steps” though. 
I’ve emailed the support option and have not gotten any reply back. 
*Oh- and today I got a notification from them and when I opened it an “ad” popped up that wanted me to download an app- for a “phone cleaner” which was a fake app to install malware. 
I emailed them about that too. 

***I’d avoid this app until they do some work on it.

Majorly Impressed. I do a lot of walking while at work and I wasn’t even thinking about how I was losing so much weight. This App has leveled up my mindset about walking so much that I find myself looking at my results every day. If I’m not walking as much as I walked the day, night or week before, I wanna be better, do better, and set my walking goals on fire so that I stay on course. I love this app tremendously as it has changed my life so much for the better. I’ve always seen people working out and I wanted to be better, be more toned, more conditioned and fit and now I am. I haven’t been this small and healthy in years. Thank you so much cause you’ve really changed my life.

Does not track distance on treadmill. I have two issues with this app:
1. On outdoor walks, distances are displayed on the app as miles and announced as miles, but the actual number announced is kilometers. For example, the app will display 3.1 miles but will announce “5.0 miles”. 
2. I changed the setting to treadmill and it tracked steps and time only. Despite having a stride length in settings, steps recorded on my treadmill walk were not translated into distance.
